segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I have you down for 38 seats to start, with the option to add the warehouse team later. Is that still the right count for May 15 go-live?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's right. Thirty-eight named users. If the pilot in Dallas goes well, we'd add 12 more in July, but I don't want those on the first invoice.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Makes sense. The order form would show 38 seats at $82 per seat per month, billed annually, so $37,392 for the first year. The additional 12 can be added later at the same unit rate through a standard add-on.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Procurement asked about term length. We prefer a 12-month term, not 24, and net 30 on the invoice.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, 12 months is fine, May 15, 2026 through May 14, 2027, net 30. No auto-renewal unless you choose to keep it, and I'll make sure the renewal notice language is clear in the agreement.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. On implementation, we need the admin training before Memorial Day. Our operations manager is out the week of May 26.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. I confirmed with our services lead this morning: kickoff on May 16, admin training May 21 at 1 p.m. Eastern, and end-user session May 23. Those dates will be listed in the implementation summary attached to the agreement.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. The only other thing is billing. We need the invoice to reference PO 44718 and list our legal entity as Northstar Packaging, LLC.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No problem. The order form will use Northstar Packaging, LLC, PO 44718, and the billing contact as ap@northstarpackaging.com. I'll send it over today for signature, and once it's signed you'll get the kickoff calendar invite the same day.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. Send it to me and copy Marcus in procurement. If the numbers match what you just said, we should be able to sign by Friday.
